```plato

// A gradient that varies linearly from Start to End, constant along lines
// perpendicular to the segment joining them.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Color_gradient)
type LinearGradient2D
    implements IValue
{
    Start: Point2D;
    End: Point2D;
    Gradient: ColorGradient;
    Spread: GradientSpread;
}
```
